change: Workload MR4xNR16 SDOT with an independent original-S25 generic MR8xNR8 API
working_hypothesis: Replacing widened dot products and complete int32 Attention outputs with byte operands and a fixed SDOT consumer removes conversion and staging costs
costs_introduced: Packed A/B microtiles and local accumulators
Alias copy and checked fallback for unsupported core shapes
predictions: Every generic tile uses two 8x8 learner planes and original packing/reuse counts
Low bytes agree with independent uint32 modulo oracle, including tails and alias handling
Ownership is released after each invocation and failed allocation leaves output unchanged
contradictions: Packing reads past a logical tail or uninitialized padding reaches a consumer
Accumulator overflow or low-byte narrowing differs from scalar semantics
unavoidable_changes: Attention allocation sizes and later allocator state
Phase counters can include changed surrounding setup and memory-system effects
retained_alternatives: Original MR8 generic and low-level SMMLA interfaces restored; MR4 remains available for the separate blocked path
interpretation: The result tests a core with its required byte interfaces and packing, not an isolated instruction substitution; no new performance claim
scope_separation: QK/SV explicitly select the temporary MR4 producer, so E11 changes blocking without changing its core. The public generic API uses original MR8 selection conditions throughout.
